subject: A Sad Day
author: ichienkai
body:
He was one of my favourite actors and its upsetting to see so many disrespectful comments out there in the news already.  I've seen every film he's made from the beginning of his career and enjoyed them all - a rare talent and a very sad time for his family and fans.

--Bootleg is a window lickin' stalker--
